title: Resident Benefits Schedule: On-Campus Courtesy on Re-Leveled Respite Nights
content:
Larkspur independent living residents who take an Assisted Living Respite Stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement receive a courtesy on the care increase of a level-change segment.

**Schedule entry.** The on-campus resident courtesy on the re-leveled nights is five percent (5 percent) for a guest whose active Larkspur independent living residency is at the same community as the stay, two percent (2 percent) for a guest whose active Larkspur independent living residency is at another community, and nothing (0 percent) for any other guest.

**How it is taken.** The courtesy reduces the care increase billed per re-leveled night by its percentage of that care increase as it stands: the amount is multiplied by 95 percent at a 5 percent courtesy and by 98 percent at a 2 percent courtesy.

The records read are the guest's Independent Living Residency Agreement in active status and its Larkspur community, compared with the community of the stay.

| Guest's Independent Living Residency Agreement | Its community against the stay's | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Same community | 5 percent |
| Active | Another community | 2 percent |
| None active | — | 0 percent |

## Hypothetical illustrations (care increase billed 40.00 per re-leveled night as it stands)

| Guest | Care increase billed per re-leveled night after the courtesy |
|---|---|
| Active residency at the stay's own community | 40.00 times 95 percent, that is 38.00 |
| Active residency at another Larkspur community | 40.00 times 98 percent, that is 39.20 |
| Residency vacated last year | 40.00, no courtesy |
